_comment: Hash pins pairing Mac sections with the shared ports that mirror them. When a test says a section is stale: mirror the change on the other side, then run python desktop/shared/parity_pins.py --pair <pair> --note "<what was mirrored>" in the same commit. The shared side is covered by the behaviour suites (tests/desktop_launcher, tests/desktop_page), not by pins.

mac.swift.page_events.end: // Closing the window quits the app; quitting stops the server.

page.note: phase 2: shared page ported from the Swift window

launcher.note: phase 2: Python launcher ported from launcher.sh run-time half; Windows: timed-out port probe is free, append-only log handles, logged unexpected errors, independent guard duties, stale-lock start-time check; Python-only (nothing in launcher.sh to mirror): lifeline reads the raw stdin fd, guard install is idempotent across loads; hardening (Python-only, launcher.sh has no counterpart): usage errors exit 1, stop checked before the warm-up, tmp-file open retried, a lock that will not go is logged, no server.base without server.port; serve_guard also ignores secrets.toml (Windows-only until Mac adoption)
